name: plan-comparison-section
purpose: The feature-by-feature matrix under the plan cards on Pricing: one column per plan with its name and action button pinned in the header while the page scrolls, one band per product with an overline, a title and a lead, and one row per feature saying what each plan includes — an included mark, a not-included mark, or the allowance as text. The recommended plan carries an accent bar, and below the large breakpoint the table folds to one plan picked from a searchable select. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'plan-comparison-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `select`, `input`, `button`, `icon-button`, `popover`, `tooltip`, `eyebrow`, `tag` and `link`.
useWhen: Use PlanComparisonSection for a feature matrix across plans or support tiers: on Pricing under the plan cards, product by product, and on Support with one column per support tier.
avoidWhen: To compare Azion with one competitor → use `competitor-comparison-section`.
For price cards with a billing-period toggle → use `pricing-plans-section`.
related: `pricing-plans-section` — the plan cards this matrix sits under.
bestPractices: Give every plan a stable `id`; the narrow-screen picker selects by it.
Mark one plan `highlighted`; it gets the accent bar, the secondary button and opens the picker.
Give every row's `values` one entry per plan, in plan order.
Use a row's `hint` to define the term its label names; it opens in a popover titled with the label, so it can run to a sentence or two.
Set `includedLabel` and `excludedLabel` to the page's words; left empty, the marks read the locale's Included and Not included.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: columnLabel
props.doc: Heading of the feature column, shown from the large breakpoint up.

props.name: pickerAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the plan picker shown below the large breakpoint.

props.name: includedLabel
props.doc: Tooltip and screen-reader text of an included cell; empty uses the locale catalog (`Included`).

props.name: excludedLabel
props.doc: Tooltip and screen-reader text of a not-included cell; empty uses the locale catalog (`Not included`).

props.name: plans
props.doc: The plan columns, in order; each is `{ id, name, description?, highlighted?, action }` with `action` as `{ label, href }`; a plan without a name is dropped.

props.name: sections
props.doc: The product bands, in order; each is `{ eyebrow, title, description, rows, action? }` (`action` closes the band, `{ label, href }`) and a row is `{ label, values, group?, hint?, tag? }` with one value per plan: `true` or `✓` is included, `—` is not included, other text shows as written, empty is blank; `hint` defines the label in a popover.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Closing link under the table, opened in a new tab; `{ label, href }`. Omitted when absent.
